title: Career Roadmap · Commis Chef
summary: A Commis Chef is an entry-level kitchen professional who prepares ingredients, assists senior chefs, follows recipes, maintains food hygiene and supports efficient kitchen operations.

facts.Current degree: Diploma in Hotel Management / Culinary Arts / Catering Technology

blocks.label: Recommended stream
blocks.text: Any stream; Science is not mandatory for most culinary programmes.

blocks.label: Important subjects
blocks.text: English, basic mathematics, food science and nutrition where available.

blocks.label: Admission
blocks.text: Depends on the diploma, institute and current entrance requirements.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Cooking methods, regional cuisines, baking, plating and kitchen organisation.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Knife safety, teamwork, time management, cleanliness and attention to detail.

items.text: Diploma in Food Production → Kitchen operations, food preparation and entry-level chef roles.
Diploma in Hotel Management → Kitchen, food-and-beverage and wider hospitality opportunities.
Diploma in Catering Technology → Food preparation, catering and institutional kitchen operations.
Diploma / certificate in Culinary Arts → Practical cooking techniques and kitchen specialisation.
B.Sc. Hospitality / Hotel Administration → Broader hospitality management and career progression.

blocks.label: Entrance exams
blocks.text: NCHM JEE is used for admission to participating B.Sc. Hospitality and Hotel Administration programmes; it is not a universal requirement for every diploma. Verify current admission notifications.

blocks.text: These are options to investigate, not a verified ranking or confirmation that each offers the exact diploma. Check current course availability, accreditation, practical kitchen hours, fees and placement details.

blocks.label: Training stage 1
blocks.text: Kitchen hygiene, knife safety, mise en place and basic cooking methods.

blocks.label: Stage 2
blocks.text: Stocks, sauces, soups, vegetables, grains, meat or vegetarian preparation, according to the kitchen section.

blocks.label: Stage 3
blocks.text: Section rotations, recipe consistency, portion control, food costing and service timing.

blocks.label: Final stage
blocks.text: Practical assessment, internship evaluation and job preparation.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Standardised recipe cards • Food-waste tracker • Kitchen mise-en-place checklist • Portion-costing spreadsheet.

blocks.label: Hotels / resorts
blocks.text: Hotel kitchens, banquet kitchens and specialty restaurants.

blocks.label: Other employers
blocks.text: Restaurants, catering companies, institutional kitchens, cruise operators and food-service businesses.

blocks.label: Ideal exposure
blocks.text: Hot kitchen, cold kitchen, bakery/pastry, food preparation and kitchen inventory.

NCHMCT’s Diploma in Food Production includes practical kitchen training and industrial training; the official course page describes a 1.5-year programme. Confirm the current structure and availability with the institute.

blocks.text: Kitchen experience → Pastry, bakery, garde manger or cuisine specialisation.
